feedback.fault_handling_gap: Current endpoint observations do not prove an intact feedback lead or a valid OFF state. A disconnected lead must never become an OFF/start permission.
feedback.candidate_resolution: Prove supervised wiring or independently qualified operating-current feedback after measuring ON/OFF current ranges; no current sensor selected yet. Monitor-side supply voltage and low current alone do not prove the downstream device connection.

start_rule: One intentional bounded contact pulse only when supply and feedback are valid and stable OFF is independently qualified; never pulse for ON or UNKNOWN
retry_policy: No blind repeated button presses. A failed/unconfirmed start becomes a visible fault/manual recovery condition. Manual OFF does not trigger an immediate loop of new presses.
TX_control: Own sonar transmissions remain separately gated; automatic power-on never grants TX permission
